title: Cosinusoid
description: This modpack is specially designed to increase your FPS!
body:
### 1. About this modpack:
The goal of this modpack is to achieve the highest possible FPS
### 2. Warning:
 1. If you want to add **graphical mods**, they **might not work**. This pack uses **VulkanMod** for better performance, so many **OpenGL-based mods won't be compatible**.
 2. Make sure your **GPU supports Vulkan**

You will need [**Java 22 or higher**](https://download.oracle.com/graalvm/25/latest/graalvm-jdk-25_windows-x64_bin.zip) with the following arguments:
 
### 
```java
--enable-preview --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED
```
